author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m notching this big tile with my grinder. I cut to the inside of my lines and polish the tiles smooth while maintaining accurate dimensions. Dampening the back of the tile and back flat troweling it provides a strong bond to the shower wall. It’s important to keep my hands safe, so I’m wearing the Ironclad Command A9 PU gloves (use coupon code HOME10 to save 10% at ironclad.com)
title: How to Notch Big Tiles Around Shower Niches - #tileshower #bathroomrenovation #howto #sponsored
